title: Sefaria Library
description: Access Sefaria's library of Jewish texts, commentaries, and learning schedules via MCP
summary: Access Sefaria's library of Jewish texts, commentaries, and learning schedules via MCP
offersHint: Access Sefaria's library of Jewish texts, commentaries, and learning schedules via MCP · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://sefaria-mcp.shimonkolodny.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_text
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the text and metadata for a specific reference (e.g., 'Genesis.1.1' or 'Berakhot 2a')

toolsPreview.name: search_texts
toolsPreview.description: Search the Sefaria library for a query string.

toolsPreview.name: get_index
toolsPreview.description: Returns metadata for a specific text, such as section names and categories

toolsPreview.name: get_toc
toolsPreview.description: Returns the table of contents for all texts in the library, grouped by category

toolsPreview.name: get_links
toolsPreview.description: Returns a list of known connections (commentary, citations, etc.) for a specific text segment

toolsPreview.name: get_topics
toolsPreview.description: Returns a list of JSON objects containing metadata for topics in the database

toolsPreview.name: get_calendars
toolsPreview.description: Returns daily learning schedules (Parashat Hashavua, Daf Yomi, etc.) for a specific date

toolsPreview.name: get_versions
toolsPreview.description: Returns available text versions for a specific reference

toolsPreview.name: get_shape
toolsPreview.description: Returns the structure and section counts for a specific text reference
